content.text: You sign in with your email address and a password. The first time, we send a six-digit code to that address to prove it's yours.
Open the link in your invitation, or go to the portal's address.
Type your email and your password.
If you forgot it, choose Forgot password. We email a six-digit code, and you pick a new password.
Use the same email address the invitation went to. A different address won't find your account.
If something here doesn't match what you see, reply to the email that brought you here and we'll sort it out.

content.text: An invoice arrives by email and in your Inbox. You can pay it right in the portal.
Open the invoice from the email, your Inbox, or Payments.
Check the amount and the due date.
Choose how to pay and enter your details. They go straight to our payment provider; we never see your card number.
You get a receipt by email, and the invoice shows as paid.
If a payment doesn't go through, you'll see why on the invoice, and you can try another way.
If something here doesn't match what you see, reply to the email that brought you here and we'll sort it out.

content.text: An invoice arrives by email and in your Inbox. You can pay it right in the portal.
Open the invoice from the email, your Inbox, or Payments.
Check the amount and the due date.
Choose how to pay and enter your details. They go straight to our payment provider; we never see your card number.
You get a receipt by email, and the invoice shows as paid.
If a payment doesn't go through, you'll see why on the invoice, and you can try another way.
If something here doesn't match what you see, reply to the email that brought you here and we'll sort it out.

content.text: A U.S. business asks each person it pays for a W-9, so it can report what it paid you at the end of the year.
Fill in and sign a W-9, and save it as a PDF.
In the W-9 card, press Upload your W-9 (PDF) and choose the file.
The card shows it as on file. To change it later, press Replace W-9.
Each business you work for keeps its own copy, so upload it under each one. Only you and that business can see it.
If something here doesn't match what you see, reply to the email that brought you here and we'll sort it out.
